articles.title: IBX and Philadelphia Flyers launch IBX Caring MVPs to Celebrate Community Volunteers
Penguins Finalize Roster for the 2026.27 Season
Flyers Announce 2026-27 Opening Night Active Roster

away.summary: The Penguins open the 2026-27 season with a revamped roster featuring key additions like Nick Robertson, David Gustafsson, Hendrix Lapierre, Trevor van Riemsdyk, and Declan Carlile. They will be without injured players Justin Brazeau, Ryan Graves, Ben Kindel, and Bryan Rust, while Andrei Kuzmenko remains away due to personal reasons. The team relies on a mix of returning veterans and newcomers as they begin the season against their rivals.

returning: : Dan Vladar suffered a scare (upper body injury) during the second game of the preseason. However, he should be ready for opening night.
home.summary: The Flyers open their 2026-27 home slate against Pittsburgh with modest roster changes, adding goaltender Joseph Woll, defenseman Simon Benoit, and forward Noel Acciari. They are relatively healthy, with only Denver Barkey (IR) and Helge Grans (injured non-roster) sidelined, while Dan Vladar is confirmed to start after recovering from an upper-body injury. The team leans on a blend of youth and experience, aiming to improve on a struggling power play.
